def encrypt(text, n):
    if text is None or text == '' or n <= 0:
        return text
    result = text
    for _ in range(n):
        evens = result[1::2]
        odds = result[0::2]
        result = evens + odds
    return result

def decrypt(encrypted_text, n):
    if encrypted_text is None or encrypted_text == '' or n <= 0:
        return encrypted_text
    result = encrypted_text
    length = len(result)
    for _ in range(n):
        mid = length // 2
        if length % 2 == 0:
            evens = result[:mid]
            odds = result[mid:]
        else:
            evens = result[:mid]
            odds = result[1:]
            evens = result[:mid]
            odds = result[mid+1:]
            temp = []
            for i in range(mid):
                temp.append(odds[i])
                temp.append(evens[i])
            temp.append(evens[-1])
            result = ''.join(temp)
            continue
        temp = []
        for i in range(mid):
            temp.append(odds[i])
            temp.append(evens[i])
        result = ''.join(temp)
    return result
